title: epipactis parviflora
intro: Epipactis parviflora, commonly known as the fairy orchid or lesser helleborine, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis parviflora include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis parviflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
